storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Horror Story
storyTemplate.description: A horror start: enter a dead roadside motel and survive the first sign that something is wrong.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The car dies under the Starling Motel sign just as the last light drains from the road.

The office window glows weakly, but no one stands behind the desk. A vacancy sign clicks on and off in the wind. Far down the road, something moves between the trees and stops when you look at it.

The motel door is closer than the dark woods.
